shortIntro.title: Can Your Phone Handle Tower of Fantasy? Let’s Break It Down 🌍⚡
shortIntro.para1: Tower of Fantasy isn’t just another mobile RPG — it’s a full open-world experience packed with fast combat, real-time exploration, and flashy anime-style abilities.
shortIntro.para2: From climbing mountains to chaotic boss fights, your device needs serious power. Weak hardware means stutters, slow rendering, and missed combos 😬🔥.

intro: Below are the latest minimum and recommended requirements to run Tower of Fantasy smoothly on Android and iOS — whether you're exploring solo or grinding bosses with your squad 😎.

minimum.Internet: Stable connection required – open-world loading depends on it 🌐

recommended.Internet: Fast Wi-Fi or 5G for seamless world loading

ios_intro: On iOS, Tower of Fantasy runs smoother thanks to Apple’s tight hardware optimization. Expect stable animations and better texture loading even during heavy exploration 🧈.

ios_recommended.title: Storage
ios_recommended.value: 15GB+ for smooth patches and open-world assets

fps_intro: Frame rate plays a massive role in Tower of Fantasy. Smooth FPS means better combat timing, faster dodges, and cleaner exploration visuals 🌄.
settings_intro: Optimizing graphics settings can dramatically improve performance without ruining visuals 🎯.

faqIntroText: Common Tower of Fantasy questions — simple and clear answers 👇:

faqList.question: Is Tower of Fantasy heavy on mobile?
faqList.answer: Yes. It’s a large open-world game that requires strong hardware for smooth gameplay.

faqList.question: Can I play it on 4GB RAM?
faqList.answer: Yes, but expect lower graphics and occasional lag during combat or exploration.

faqList.question: Why does Tower of Fantasy lag or stutter?
faqList.answer: The game loads large environments in real-time, which stresses CPU, GPU, and RAM.
